entity.description:
Goku and the Future Warrior in Black launch their Father-Son Kamehameha at the opponent but struggle to make headway. Xeno Bardock then joins them and fires Rebellion Trigger. All three then power up to their most powerful forms to unleash more energy, causing their attacks to combine into one mighty energy wave.

In the Supreme Kai of Time Saga, when Super Saiyan 3 Xeno Bardock arrives to help and adds his Rebellion Trigger to the Father-Son Kamehameha used by Super Saiyan Blue Goku and the darkness-enhanced Super Saiyan Future Warrior in Black, it turns into a makeshift Family Kamehameha - the 3 Generations Kamehameha. The combined resolve of the past, present and future proves more than a match for Demigra's Chaotic Gigantes, and when Goku, Future Warrior in Black, and Xeno Bardock awaken their respective transformations, the energy wave gains enough power to force the blast back considerably, overcoming it and putting a decisive end to the mad demon warlord.

In Dragon Ball Heroes, Goku (UGM9-SEC) uses it as his "Fighting Together Across Time" Super Ability, Super Warriors Linked By Blood Across Time.
